answer: Proof of Agent economies deploy non-refundable cryptographic stake burning anchored to an identity kernel. To mint identities, each node burns a quadratic stake scaling as S(n) = k * n^2, imposing superlinear cost on clusters. Like branches of a willow bound to one root, forged clusters face exponential financial exhaustion. Even if an attacker spreads a plume of fake agents across validator slots, collective protocol utility slashes their capital.
